**Robustness — the tag does not survive its own inputs**

- IWM accounts for **52.5% of all kept volume**, and every IWM row in the kept set expires **today** (0DTE).
- Same-day index flow is two-way by construction — it is exactly the structural noise the skill's own exclusion list warns about for broad-index products.
- It is large enough here to pull the aggregate ratio from CALL to MIXED, i.e. the headline tag is being set by the least interpretable flow in the set.

Reading the flow:

- **NVDA carries the cleanest directional signal.** Core call volume 59,995 vs put volume 6,318 (P/C 0.11), anchored by NVDA call 215 exp 10-21 —
- 59,995 contracts against OI 2,274, V/OI 26.4, −0.7% OTM. Near-ATM, next-day, real open interest, and little opposing flow.
- The only notable put is NVDA 237.5 exp 10-26 (6,318 contracts, OI 69, +9.7% OTM) — real size but thin OI, so a notable line rather than a conviction signal.
- **AAPL is the biggest single-name book but is NOT a clean directional call bet.** Strike 340 exp 10-21 traded on *both* sides —
- call 32,284 (OI 631) and put 63,860 (OI 3,550) — and 337.5 carries 40,997 of put volume alongside 69,929 of call volume at 342.5 and 61,334 at 345.
- A two-way cluster at the same strikes and the same expiry is the signature of a straddle/roll or market-maker position, not of a directional view.
- AAPL's call lean in the table above should not be read as conviction.
- **GOOGL and AMZN lean call** on the core slice (P/C 0.41 and 0.30), though GOOGL 337.5 exp 10-21 is itself two-way (1,320 call vs 9,093 put) and is doing much of the opposing work.
- **TLT is the one put-leaning name** (P/C 1.55) — the only genuine counter-signal in the core set.
- Heavy put volume far ITM (AAPL/NVDA deep-ITM lines in section 1) is closing or exercise-related activity, **not** a deep bearish view; OI is the tell —
- those strikes carry OI of only a few hundred or less.
- The IWM 0DTE book (52.5% of volume) runs both directions in size — calls 276/277 and puts 275/274/276, all expiring today.
- It is reported because the skill keeps IWM in the universe, but it should not be read as positioning.

**Deviations from the original procedure**

- **Data source substituted.** `mcp__tradingview-advanced__stock_options_unusual_activity` is absent from this runtime:
- not in the tool list, `tool_search` returns 0 hits across tradingview/option/finance queries, and the App/Connector catalog holds 15 tools (13 media + 2 credential) with no market-data capability.
- The cron preamble's advertised `mcp__yahoo_finance__*` is **also absent — that preamble line is stale**.
- The scan ran against the crumb-authenticated Yahoo Finance options chain (`fc.yahoo.com` cookie → `query1/v1/test/getcrumb` → `query2/v7/finance/options/<sym>`), reproducing `top_n=10, min_volume=100, expiries=4` semantics locally.
- Field mapping is 1:1 (volume, openInterest, impliedVolatility, inTheMoney, strike, lastPrice); V/OI, moneyness and DTE are computed here.
- **Pass A skipped** — `research/watchlist.yaml` is not present in this workspace, so coverage is the 8 Pass B names only.
- **Run time.** The fire landed at 16:31 ET, after the 16:00 ET close, rather than the skill's 09:55 ET target.
- Volume is therefore final full-session for the date rather than a ~25-minute post-open sample — a more settled signal, but not directly comparable to a 09:55 ET run.
- **Sections 0, 2b and the OI-floor analysis are additions beyond the skill spec.** Ranking on V/OI alone surfaces fragile rows at the top;
- that is a property of the metric rather than a data error, but it needs stating.
